name: VPDriven Issuer (DCQL verifier)
description: Issues a Membership Card pre-filled from a National ID requested with a DCQL query
summary: NOOP wallet illustrating a VPDriven issuer whose referenced verifier requests the presented credential with a DCQL query (dc+sd-jwt) instead of a DIF Presentation Exchange definition. A Membership Card (jwt_vc_vcdm) is issued with firstName and familyName copied, via issuerConfiguration.mapping, from a National ID the holder presents. Use DCQL when interfacing with the EUDI wallet. Works only with the in-time authorized issuance flow.
